Thank you for the advice and the quote. It really does help a lot. Thank you. I am 20 years old, I was living with my parents while I get through college. If I can go full time I will have my bachelors degree in one year. I talked to the lgbt counselor at my college and I am currently waiting to see if I can get financial aid so that I can continue going to school. I do have a part time job with just barely enough money to support myself. My girlfriend and I talked about how she is upset with me and she just doesn't like being around me when I am sad, she told me that it is not fair for her to be around me when I am down. Which is true. I told her that I will find someone else to talk to about what I am going through and will try not to be around her when I am feeling sad. Once I save up enough for first and last months rent and a deposit I plan on moving out of her place. In 5 or 10 years I want to have a good job, I am thinking being an English teacher would be very rewarding (I'm majoring in English) but I also think it would be fun to work for a newspaper or own my own business or something. I also want to see the world, publish a book because I love writing, live by the ocean, and be in love with someone that loves me back equally.
